tasks.final_text: THe 1954 Atlantic hurrican season was an above-average Atlantic hurrican season in terms of named storms, with 16 forming. Overall, the season resulted in $751.6 million in damage, the most of any season at the time. The season officially began on June 15, and nine days later the first named storm developed.
